expression_format: Python ast.unparse; null default plus required=true means no default; string "None" is an explicit None default. Annotation strings retain their AST quoting. No runtime imports used.
error_coverage: Exact explicit raise expressions in named native modules; this is NOT an exhaustive list of dependency/callback exceptions. Scope names distinguish internal helpers. Errors are not root exports.

callbacks.load_model.check_interrupted: Callable[[], bool] | None; four phase polls; true raises canonical LoadInterrupted; exceptions unchanged.
callbacks.run_diffusion.on_frame: Callable[[DiffusionFrame], None] | None; every captured step, after retention, independent of keep_frames; error propagates. Tier-2 callback sees full live distribution before retention budget clears stored copies.
callbacks.run_diffusion.should_cancel: Callable[[], bool] | None; capture before cancel before writers; true yields native partial result; no engine cancel registry.
callbacks.run_diffusion.logit_hook: ForwardHookFn | None retained verbatim; alias in hooks.py is Callable[[Any, tuple, Any], Any]. Non-None caller input rejected by ingress, do not turn into a newly enabled API.

identity_rule: root.name is native.name; preserve __module__, signature, annotations, function defaults and canonical class identity. Implementation modules remain private even when imported transitively.
